title: Phishing awareness quiz
summary: Look at realistic example messages and decide which ones are suspicious, with an explanation of the warning signs for each.

title: Privacy checklist
summary: A step-by-step checklist for reviewing the privacy settings and habits that affect how much of your information is exposed.

title: Social engineering scenario
summary: An interactive scenario where you choose how to respond to a manipulation attempt and see how each choice plays out.

title: Security risk self-assessment
summary: Answer a short set of questions about your accounts and devices to identify the areas most worth improving first.

title: URL & domain information tool
summary: Break down a link into its parts and explain what each part means, to help spot look-alike and misleading addresses.

title: Data exposure checklist
summary: Work through the common places personal or organisational information ends up publicly visible, and what to check in each.

title: Security awareness exercises
summary: Short, self-paced exercises that build the habit of pausing and checking before clicking, sharing, or signing in.
